principle: The operator must not be required to type the next implementation, review, or remediation instruction. Automation continues all automatable work autonomously until V2 is fully migrated or only true operator/external/event/position-dependent blockers remain.

classification_taxonomy.AUTOMATABLE_NOW: Work that the closed-loop Spark/worker pool can execute right now: implementation tasks, review tasks, remediation tasks, watcher refreshes, indexer runs, miner cycles.
classification_taxonomy.OPERATOR_DECISION_REQUIRED: Numeric threshold, risk cap, capital recovery, checkpoint promotion, or acceptance decision that only a signed operator can resolve.
classification_taxonomy.EXTERNAL_SOURCE_REQUIRED: Third-party API key by name or paid-feed access the operator has not yet approved. Names-only checks; raw values never read.
classification_taxonomy.EVENT_DEPENDENT: Real-world event must occur (e.g. per-symbol liquidation observation). No synthetic completion permitted.
classification_taxonomy.POSITION_DEPENDENT: Real open position or exchange state that V2 cannot fabricate (e.g. manual quarantine confirmation). No synthetic completion permitted.
classification_taxonomy.UNSAFE_TO_AUTOMATE: Any work whose automation would breach the hard prohibitions (live enable, canary enable, shutdown approval, Redis trim, old Redis writes, exchange mutation, checkpoint deserialization without operator approval, paid-feed activation without operator approval).

rules.summary: Every Report Center next action MUST be classified into exactly one taxonomy bucket.
If AUTOMATABLE_NOW: create a Claude implementation task, create a paired Codex review task, enqueue both into the Spark/worker pool, and workers must lease and execute.
On Codex FAIL: create a remediation task if the failure is safely automatable, OR classify as OPERATOR_DECISION_REQUIRED or UNSAFE_TO_AUTOMATE. Never leave a Codex FAIL unmapped.
If queue is empty but mission blockers remain: autoseed the next safe task. Otherwise emit the exact reason all remaining blockers are operator/event/external/position dependent.
Report Center must surface every autonomy field (see report_center_autonomy_surface_contract.json).
Workers must not stop the report center, replay miner, Spark worker pool, Codex governors, V2 paper runtime, or event watchers.
Hard prohibitions on automation. No exceptions without explicit operator signature.

termination_conditions: V2 is fully migrated AND legacy is stopped under a separate operator-signed runbook.
Only OPERATOR_DECISION_REQUIRED / EXTERNAL_SOURCE_REQUIRED / EVENT_DEPENDENT / POSITION_DEPENDENT blockers remain and Report Center emits the exact reason.
do_not_terminate_when: Queue is temporarily empty but unclassified backlog items exist (autoseed instead).
A single Codex FAIL is unresolved (map it: remediation task or operator classification).
A worker leased and failed (retry per worker-pool policy or remediation).
